'''December 1999 Greensboro tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Craig's Cards and Collectables, Greensboro, NC on 5 December 1999. [[Scott Anderson]] won it. It is known from Leonard Mitchell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d138">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99d138/ greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99], DeckTech (Leonard "Master Yoda" Mitchell, 6 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99d138/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Craig's Cards and Collectables, Greensboro, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Scott Anderson]]
